name: Sveti Stefan in a day
description_md:
Sveti Stefan in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Sveti Stefan in ME.

This route features 5 sightseeing stops connected by 9.5 km of walking between stops. The full day takes about 6.3 hours, with visit time at each stop included.
